title: Structure engineering work index
description: A two-column work index on paper: a huge heading at the top left with a lead, outlined mono tags and an arrow button at the bottom, then a hairline and a column of ruled project rows (bold uppercase name at the left, near-square image at the right) that slides up through a 900px window as the page scrolls past. A hovered row turns ink and shows a 'view' box over its image. On phones the rows become a sideways track of wide cards that slides left with the scroll.
notes: the list moves with a CSS view timeline on the section; without support it is a plain list (desktop) or a sideways-scrolling row (phones)
best with five or more projects so the list is taller than its 900px window
